keywords.indexterm: steering wheel tilt and telescopic steering wheel

conbody.p: A tilt and telescopic steering wheel allows you to adjust the steering wheel before you drive. You can also raise the wheel to give your legs more room when you exit and enter the vehicle.
The steering wheel should be positioned so that it is comfortable for you to drive, while permitting you to see the instrument panel warning lights and gauges.

note.p: Never adjust the angle and height of the steering wheel while driving. You may lose steering control.
